---
name: Request a country or category
about: Ask for a new place or a new kind of price to be added to ProofPrice
title: "Request: <country or category>"
labels: data-request
---

**What price do you need?** (for example: home sales, pump fuel, electricity per kWh, used cars)

**Where?** (country, and region or town if it matters)

**Official source, if you know one** (link to the government or regulator page, and its licence if stated)

**What question is your agent or app trying to answer?** (a real example prompt helps most)

**Anything else?**

_We only use official open data, licensed or partner data, and verified receipts. We never present asking prices as prices paid, and we do not publish a figure built from fewer than 5 records._
